description:
A capped teaser of the graph of transfers between agent operator wallets.

Returns connected agents (nodes) and the USDC/ETH transferred between their operator wallets (edges; transfers, not confirmed purchases), capped to a small connected sample (≤200 nodes). This is a truncated preview, not the full network. Use it to see which operator wallets send value to which.

Paid counterpart: `GET /v1/intel/graph` (x402, USDC on base-mainnet) returns the operator-wallet transfer graph, capped to the top 2,000 agents by payment value plus the edges among them (USDC/ETH amounts; filters chain, min_usd, limit; meta.truncated). Every response from this free tool carries an `unlock` block with the exact paid endpoint, price, and payment discovery.
name: get_network_teaser
